verdict.rationale: Runpod documents API-key authentication for its REST API, MCP server and Flash CLI. However, nothing in the evidence shows that keys can be scoped to specific resources or permissions, made read-only, or otherwise issued with least privilege for an agent. Plain API-key auth is an adjacent feature and does not deliver scoped credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
